lines.en: My enormous body shifts slowly forward.
A cold blue light glows under my scales.

lines.zh: 尾鳍扫过地面，留下水痕
lines.en: My tail sweeps the ground, leaving wet marks.

lines.zh: 八点护甲在背上排成行
lines.en: My plating runs in rows down my back.
The ground trembles with each step.
My long barbels sway out in front of me.
I follow the coastal rocks.
The smell of seawater comes with me.
The grass flattens where I pass.
I pause once, then continue.
Standing still as a reef stone.
My dorsal fin opens and closes.
Water drips from between my scales.
My barbels probe the air.
My eye rolls slowly around.
My pectoral fins tap at my sides.
I draw one heavy breath.

lines.zh: 身上渗出的水汇成一小滩
lines.en: Seepage pools into a small puddle.
A low call from my kin sounds far off.
I wait, patient as tide.
My scales throw the light back.
My body is still. The water is not.
This is too far from the sea.
I fold my pectoral fins in.
A watery sound rolls in my throat.
I seem to be listening for something.
I lower my head to you slowly.
You look like a small meal.
A seaborn's eye does not blink.
I turn my head to the side.
You took three steps back. I noticed.
My barbels reach toward you.
This land is turning into sea.

lines.zh: 五百六十点血，我在海底攒的。
lines.en: Five hundred sixty health, saved on the seabed.
I'm in no hurry. You can't escape.
My shadow covers you.
My plating pales in the light.
Consider this look a record of you.
The water seeping from the wound turns cloudy.
I draw back half a step.
My plating took most of it.
That one had some weight.
No cry. Only a look.
The water inside me sloshes once.
Pain on land is unfamiliar.
My barbels are trembling.
I'll mark that down.
You found a seam.
The smell of flesh. I know it.
That much is a single mouthful.
I lower my head, unhurried.
Things of the land can be eaten too.
Water drips from my jaw.
How many times can you feed me?

lines.zh: 我的牙不适合嚼，只适合撕
lines.en: My teeth don't chew. They tear.
Just a little closer.
This smell reminds me of the deep.
When it's gone I'll want more.
What you hit was plating.
I haven't given one step.
Eight points of armor. You can't dent it.

lines.zh: 水从我身上溅到你脸上
lines.en: Water splashes from me onto your face.
One flick of my fin slides you away.
Don't walk along my flank.
That one doesn't count as an attack.
I turn my head square to you.
The barnacles on me are hard.
You stepped on my fin.
My kin are only in the deep.
I give out a low string of notes.
No answer. This place is too shallow.
The eggs must hatch in salt water.
This armor took years to grow.
I turn my body sideways.
Water sounds stand in for words.
We know each other by scent.

lines.zh: 海嗣的伴侣关系很简单
lines.en: Seaborn bonds are simple things.
We'll speak when the tide rises.
My barbels curl and lift it.
I hold it in my mouth and taste.
Too hard. Two bites and I spit it out.

lines.zh: 这点血肉，塞不住我的牙。
lines.en: This much flesh won't fill my teeth.
I wedge it between my scales.
Bland, but edible.
I raise my head and look about.
Save it for the deep.
The water has softened it.
Swallowed. Nothing to note.
You've entered my waters.

lines.zh: 六十四格，我早看见你了
lines.en: Sixty blocks out, I already saw you.
I swing round to face you.
My kin far off stir too.
Water seeps from under my scales.
The ground turns damp under me.
No call. Just walking.
Retreating to shore won't help.
The sea will swallow this place.
You're just meat that moves.
Prey swims, and prey walks the shore.
My plating rises plate by plate.
This weight will press you flat.
I strike villagers too.
The iron one as well.
Snow golems aren't exempt.
Then let it begin here.
You have a few seconds.
A deep-sea eye keeps watching you.
You aren't running. That's easier.
The deep is on my side.
I can wait all day.
My barbels probe near your feet.
Your strength leaks away by degrees.

lines.zh: 这身甲不是为了跑得快
lines.en: This armor wasn't grown for speed.
It's so nothing reaches the inside.
Seven hits so far. I've counted.
And I need only one.
My blood is salt water.
Do you smell rain?
It's not rain. It's the sea.
There's water behind you.
And I've closed the way.
Now only the front is left.
Then come at my front.
The tide is out, and you have nowhere to run.
Don't blink at this moment.
You'd miss the last one.
My whole bulk bears down on you.
One toss of my head sends you sliding.
A pectoral fin slaps your chest.

lines.zh: 长须缠了一下你的手腕
lines.en: A barbel coils your wrist once.
My teeth tear your armor open.
Slow, but heavy.
You block it, and your feet sink.
I turn broadside and press you down.
My tail sweeps the back of your knee.
My plating cuts your sleeve open.
Water crashes down with me.
That one missed.
You're quicker than you look.
I'll try again.
The water splits and I climb ashore.
Seaweed still hangs from my plating.

lines.zh: 我踩下的地方积成水洼
lines.en: Puddles form where I tread.
A salt smell spreads first.
I raise my head and scan the land.
The tide is still falling behind me.
This isn't a natural sea.
I was called out.
I smell living things.
The water inside me trembles.
I settle, then take the first step.
This shore will change soon enough.

lines.zh: 长须探了探前方的空气
lines.en: My barbels test the air ahead.
I spread my dorsal fin.
Water drips off me, all the way down.
The grass all around is trembling.

lines.zh: 八点护甲，已经准备好了
lines.en: Eight points of armor, all set.
And there's more, deeper down.
This will be a new sea.
Starting with me.
Fire hisses white steam off my scales.
Landing rattles my body hollow.
Even in water I cannot draw breath.
The blast tears a plate loose.
It strikes between my plates.
This force swims inside my armor.
Too long from the sea. I'm drying out.

lines.zh: 雷顺着鳞甲走遍了全身
lines.en: Lightning runs across every plate.
Nothing below. No water either.
